FR-001.title: The interface MUST provide a labeled, keyboard-operable configuration tab with an editable endpoint and a save action.

FR-002.title: The configuration tab MUST identify the active endpoint and distinguish unsaved edits from saved settings.

FR-003.title: The system MUST reject invalid endpoint values with a visible reason before changing active configuration.

FR-004.title: A successful save MUST make subsequent connection, discovery, and speech requests use the saved endpoint without rebuilding the frontend image.

FR-005.title: An endpoint change MUST discard previous capability selections and ignore late discovery responses belonging to the previous endpoint.

FR-006.title: The system MUST display engine and voice selectors only for choices supported by the active service and applicable language.

FR-007.title: A service explicitly lacking discovery MUST remain usable for speech with documented compatible defaults and without unsupported selectors.

FR-008.title: The interface MUST distinguish unsupported discovery from authentication, connectivity, malformed-response, and empty-catalog failures.

FR-009.title: Configuration-save failures MUST preserve the last successfully saved endpoint and report that the attempted change was not saved.

FR-010.title: The system MUST store the shared endpoint configuration in a container-side file that can be persisted independently of the image.

FR-011.title: Saved configuration MUST survive browser reload, service restart, and container replacement when the documented persistent storage is retained.

FR-012.title: Deployment documentation MUST state the exact file path, mount target, permissions, initialization behavior, and precedence between saved and startup configuration, with a working synthetic Compose example.

FR-013.title: The system MUST keep backend credentials server-side and prevent endpoint edits from forwarding them to an operator-unauthorized destination.

FR-014.title: Configuration changes MUST be restricted to the authorized operator access boundary rather than granting arbitrary public clients control of shared routing.

FR-015.title: The feature MUST preserve existing text and audio privacy, request limits, language behavior, and playback/download behavior.
